info.subtitleNullable: Every pre-match price change from Pinnacle, Singbet, SBOBET and Bet365
info.descriptionNullable:
## About this dataset

This dataset follows the betting market for 63,597 football matches played between July 2018 and June 2026. For every match it records each pre-match price change published by four bookmakers, Pinnacle, Singbet (also known as Crown), SBOBET and Bet365, in three markets: the match result (1X2), the Asian handicap and the over/under total goals line. Every change carries a UTC timestamp, so you can replay how the odds moved from the first quote up to kick-off.

Closing odds are easy to find for free, but the path the market takes to get there usually is not. This dataset has the whole path: about 37.0 million price updates, 11.6 million for the match result, 15.6 million for the handicap and 9.8 million for totals. That makes it useful for studying line movement, measuring closing line value, checking how quickly the other books follow Pinnacle, or backtesting a model against the prices that were actually on offer at a given moment.

Every match also has its full-time and half-time score, and every handicap and totals price is labelled with how that line settled (Win, Win Half, Push, Lose Half or Lose), so there is no need to work out quarter-line settlement yourself.

## Files

There are five tables, each provided as CSV and as Parquet. The Parquet files are much smaller and faster to load, and they hold exactly the same data. Everything joins on `match_id`.

| Table | One row per |
|---|---|
| `matches` | match, with teams, kick-off, scores and the result at the closing lines |
| `odds_1x2` | price update in the match result market, per bookmaker |
| `odds_ah` | price update in the Asian handicap market, per bookmaker |
| `odds_ou` | price update in the over/under market, per bookmaker |
| `match_closing` | match and bookmaker, with opening and closing prices in all three markets |

## Competitions

The matches come from 30 top leagues and cups (the World Cup qualifiers are split by confederation, which makes 36 competition codes). European leagues and cups run from the 2018-19 season to 2025-26, leagues that play within a calendar year run from 2019 to June 2026, and international matches start in July 2018. Only finished matches are included. UEFA club competitions include their qualifying rounds, the FA Cup starts at the first round proper, and the international friendlies are senior men's teams only.

| Competition | Matches | First month | Last month |

## Coverage

The table shows the share of matches in each year for which a bookmaker has at least one price in a market.

| Bookmaker | Market | 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pinnacle | 1X2 | 96% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 98% | 99% | 98% | 98% | 99% |
| Pinnacle | Handicap | 26% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% |
| Pinnacle | Totals | 26% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% |
| Singbet | 1X2 | 98% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% |
| Singbet | Handicap | 98% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% |
| Singbet | Totals | 98% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% |
| SBOBET | 1X2 | 97% | 98% | 98% | 98% | 98% | 98% | 98% | 98% | 99% |
| SBOBET | Handicap | 97% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% |
| SBOBET | Totals | 97% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% |
| Bet365 | 1X2 | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% |
| Bet365 | Handicap | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% |
| Bet365 | Totals | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 98% | 99% | 99% | 99% | 99% |

Where a series is missing, the bookmaker simply did not price that match. This happens mostly with minor friendlies, qualifiers between small nations and early cup rounds. The one systematic gap is at the start: Pinnacle's handicap and totals history only begins on 24 November 2018, which is why those two rows are low for 2018. Pinnacle's match result prices and the other three bookmakers are complete from the start.

## Things worth knowing

Timestamps are recorded to the minute. When a bookmaker changed its price more than once in the same minute, the `seq` column keeps the updates in the right order.

Asian handicap lines are written from the home side's point of view, so -0.75 means the home team gives three quarters of a goal and +0.25 means it receives a quarter. Quarter lines are kept as .25 and .75. When a market sits between two lines, a bookmaker's main line can switch back and forth (for example -0.25 at 2.15 and 0 at 1.79). Each row carries its own line, so nothing is lost, but if you want a single fixed-line series you should filter on `line`.

The `phase` column separates the early market from the main market. Bet365 only has the main market.

Bets are settled on the score after 90 minutes plus stoppage time, as bookmakers do. For cup ties that went to extra time or penalties, those scores are in separate columns and do not affect settlement.

A few hundred of the 37.0 million prices look odd, such as a placeholder of 1.0 or a one-sided quote that is clearly stale. They are left exactly as the bookmakers published them rather than cleaned.

Team names are written the way they appeared at the time and are not always consistent, so join on `home_team_id` and `away_team_id` if you need to follow a team across seasons.

## How the data was collected and checked

The prices were collected in October 2026 from publicly accessible odds comparison websites that keep the full history of bookmaker price changes. Odds were converted to decimal and all times to UTC, quotes made after kick-off were dropped, and every remaining price is at or before the scheduled kick-off.

Before publishing, every downloaded page was parsed again and compared row by row with the final tables, and a random sample of matches was downloaded a second time and compared. Neither check found a single difference. Fixtures and scores were also cross-checked against football-data.co.uk for the 14 leagues it covers. The fixture lists matched for 99.7 to 100 percent of matches and the full-time scores agreed for 99.92 to 100 percent.

## Updates

The dataset covers completed seasons, so it is not expected to change.

## Getting started

```python
import pandas as pd

matches = pd.read_parquet("matches.parquet")
ah = pd.read_parquet("odds_ah.parquet")

# How Pinnacle and Singbet moved the handicap before one match
match_id = matches.loc[matches.home_team.str.contains("Arsenal"), "match_id"].iloc[0]
moves = ah[(ah.match_id == match_id) & (ah.suspended == 0)]
pinnacle = moves[moves.bookmaker == "Pinnacle"].sort_values("seq")
singbet = moves[moves.bookmaker == "Singbet"].sort_values("seq")
aligned = pd.merge_asof(pinnacle[["ts_utc", "line", "home_odds"]],
                        singbet[["ts_utc", "line", "home_odds"]],
                        on="ts_utc", suffixes=("_pinnacle", "_singbet"))
```

Timestamps are stored as ISO 8601 text, so convert them with `pd.to_datetime` if you need them as datetimes.
